I wrote `duplicates.judgements.json` beside the evidence. I haven't run the `gnd` commands, so the CLI hasn't checked the file yet.

|---|---|---|

The `g3` rationale says the verdict follows your confirmation. The overlap with `item_has_colour` is 12 of 24 pairs, so the evidence alone didn't decide it.

Next, run these with the same model, population, `--min-support` (20) and disclosure settings that produced the evidence. Replace the uppercase placeholders:

```sh
gnd discover model.orm.yaml POPULATION --families fact-type --type-evidence-in evidence.json --duplicate-judgements duplicates.judgements.json --out proposal.json --report report.json --actor ACTOR --requested-at TIMESTAMP
gnd evolve preview model.orm.yaml proposal.json --workspace WORKSPACE --records RECORDS --out preview.json --policy additive
```

If `gnd discover` exits 3, read its message and fix the judgements file. Don't edit the evidence. If the data or model changed since the evidence was written, make new evidence and judge again.
